result.stdout:
FDW005 File Splitter - splits multi-type .cs files into one file per type.

Usage:
  dotnet fdw-split <path> [--dry-run]

Arguments:
  <path>      A .cs file, a directory, or a .csproj file
  --dry-run   Show what would be done without making changes

Examples:
  dotnet fdw-split src/MyProject/Results/ResultCodes.cs
  dotnet fdw-split src/MyProject/
  dotnet fdw-split src/MyProject/MyProject.csproj
